summary: Implemented rich_measure support for Tree and added a new VerticalCenter class. Changes: (1) rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__, which measures each node's label plus a 4-cell-per-level indent, recursing only into expanded children, clamped to max_width; added a Measurement import. (2) rich/align.py: added VerticalCenter(renderable, style=None), which renders at the available width and pads blank lines above and below to center within console.height, plus __rich_measure__ delegating to Measurement.get. VerticalCenter did not exist in the repo, so I created it; it centers against console.height rather than a layout height because ConsoleOptions has no height field. (3) CHANGELOG.md: added an Unreleased entry for both. Not done: no tests added, no tests or code run (per instructions), no commit made, and black formatting was only hand-checked for one line. Please review the VerticalCenter design choice.
